Registered API Key Credentials (Personal.title: API key credentials - Private application
Registered API Key Credentials (Personal.tooltip: Provides access tokens with privileges to access an expanded set of services and items. Safeguard these tokens as you would your username and password. Do not embed in an application.

Registered OAuth 2.0 Credentials (Person.title: OAuth 2.0 Credentials - Impersonates item owner
Registered OAuth 2.0 Credentials (Person.tooltip: Impersonates owner of this item. For security purposes, you should guard these credentials as you would guard your username and password.

Personal credential.title: Personal
Personal credential.tooltip: You are granting a personal privilege to this credential. For security purposes, you should guard any access token created with these credentials as you would guard your username and password. Please review the terms of use.
